CometAPI Connect configures the official: CometAPI Connect configures the official OpenAI-compatible generator and selected chat. If needed, it installs the bundled plugin and creates an initial CometAPI chat.
The remote generator supports a fixed mo: The remote generator supports a fixed model list. The standard Connect model selection uses GPT-4.1 mini; custom models must be supported by the plugin.
The plugin stores its API key in a priva: The plugin stores its API key in a private plaintext configuration file. Restore preserves chat messages; installed plugin files remain.
Node-based image and video workflows wit: Node-based image and video workflows with dedicated CometAPI cloud nodes.
Select a recognized ComfyUI source insta: Select a recognized ComfyUI source installation to install the CometAPI Image and CometAPI Video nodes.
Restart ComfyUI, add a CometAPI node, an: Restart ComfyUI, add a CometAPI node, and select a model and prompt. Generation uses your CometAPI account and may incur charges.
The CometAPI nodes read credentials from: The CometAPI nodes read credentials from a private configuration file outside workflow graphs. Keep that file private.
The bundled nodes require ComfyUI’s publ: The bundled nodes require ComfyUI’s public node API, comfy_api.latest. Other nodes keep their own provider and credential settings.
In a compatible source installation, use: In a compatible source installation, use .env.local as documented by .env.example.
Knowledge and context framework for AI a: Knowledge and context framework for AI applications.
Automatic setup supports recognized Pyth: Automatic setup supports recognized Python OpenAI constructors; dynamic or custom provider configurations require manual setup.
Stable Diffusion WebUI with a separate C: Stable Diffusion WebUI with a separate CometAPI cloud generation extension.
Select a recognized AUTOMATIC1111 source: Select a recognized AUTOMATIC1111 source installation to add the CometAPI cloud tab, then restart WebUI.
Choose a model and enter a prompt in the: Choose a model and enter a prompt in the CometAPI cloud tab. Cloud generation uses your CometAPI account and may incur charges.
The extension stores its API key in a pr: The extension stores its API key in a private configuration file; local txt2img and img2img settings are preserved.
The CometAPI tab is separate from local: The CometAPI tab is separate from local checkpoint generation and requires a compatible Gradio extension interface.
Select the InvokeAI data directory conta: Select the InvokeAI data directory containing invokeai.yaml. CometAPI Connect writes external_openai_api_key and external_openai_base_url to the private api_keys.yaml file.
Restart InvokeAI and select an OpenAI-ba: Restart InvokeAI and select an OpenAI-backed external image model supported by your installed version and CometAPI account.
Requires an InvokeAI version with the ex: Requires an InvokeAI version with the external OpenAI image provider and compatible api_keys.yaml settings. Canvas features and model capabilities depend on the installed version.
Local image generation with an optional: Local image generation with an optional CometAPI cloud panel.
Select a compatible Fooocus source insta: Select a compatible Fooocus source installation to add the CometAPI image/video panel, then restart Fooocus.
The cloud panel requires a compatible Gr: The cloud panel requires a compatible Gradio launch structure. CometAPI Connect previews and backs up the source change before applying it.
Some models need additional Aider metada: Some models need additional Aider metadata, such as use_temperature: false or an output allowance for reasoning. Endpoint and key setup does not configure every model capability.
Gemini CLI 0.23.0 is not supported for a: Gemini CLI 0.23.0 is not supported for automatic setup because it does not honor the isolated home setting.
Source setup requires a nextchat or chat: Source setup requires a nextchat or chatgpt-next-web package with app/api/common.ts.
Automatic setup requires a recognized Fo: Automatic setup requires a recognized Fooocus source installation with one compatible top-level Gradio launch statement in webui.py.
